purpose: Base-model pass@k for one larger instruct model on the unchanged v1 expression pack. v1 samples are not rescored.
task_pack_policy: Reuse benchmarks/heldout/exact_integer_v1/tasks.jsonl with its existing hash. No expression or prompt is redrawn from the v1 outcome.

decoder.chat_template: Required. A tokenizer without a chat template fails closed.

answer_extraction.scope: The last non-empty line must full-match the regex.
answer_extraction.relation_to_v1: Identical to the v1 grader. It is not relaxed, and prose from the v1 outputs is not added as an alternate pattern.

primary_metric: Fraction of tasks with at least one exact final line among k samples, with a Wilson 95% interval.

acceptance.stop_zero: pass_rate == 0. Do not retune and do not update.
acceptance.stop_saturated: pass_rate == 1. Do not retune the pack into a training set.
acceptance.nondegenerate_base_signal: 0 < pass_rate < 1. Authorizes only a separate update-cost smoke, not a policy-update comparison.

changed_from_v1: MLX weights are the published 4-bit mlx-community conversion

mlx.weights: Published mlx-community 4-bit conversion of Qwen/Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct. No unquantized mlx-community repository for this id was available when the revision was pinned.

transformers.machine: One CUDA GPU. float16 on CUDA, including a T4; float32 otherwise.
transformers.weights: Upstream bf16 checkpoint. This pin is not a claim that it matches the 4-bit MLX backend.
transformers.sampling: do_sample=True, temperature=0.7; torch.manual_seed(seed) before each sample

why_this_model: v1 stopped at SmolLM2-360M-Instruct. v2 keeps that pack and parser, and changes only to an instruction-tuned 3B model in the 1.5B-3B range. Qwen2.5-0.5B pairings on other tasks are not reused. No v2 output exists in the commit that adds this file.
update_comparison: scripts/heldout_exact_integer_update_comparison_v2.py exits 2. This protocol does not run best-of-n against GRPO or RFT.
does_not_establish: No v2 model output is included. A later non-degenerate result would authorize only a separate update-cost smoke, not a policy-update comparison.
